messages:
liz: quick follow-up on the host-page shim RFC — we merged the PR last night. can we start a canary on Dedicated and Private? unit tests looked good but i saw some metadata churn in the prod traces earlier.
arjun: saw that churn too. reproduces locally if host-backed pages exceed ~40% of residency. tail latency jitter (~p99) goes up by ~60ms in my runs. likely page-table walk + TLB pressure.
maria: agree on telemetry first. can we tag pages allocated via the shim with `shim.source=host` and add a residency histogram? then we can slice by customer/route.
kevin: +1. also we should keep allocator ABI stable — add a new optional call `hint_residency(pool_id, prefer_host=true)` that defaults to noop for older callers.
liz: proposed rollout plan:
  1) add telemetry tag + residency histogram in staging
  2) expose hint API (backwards compatible)
  3) enable shim in staging canary for a handful of routes
  4) if p95/p99 tail increases beyond thresholds revert
maria: telemetry snippet i can wire into tracer config:
```
residency_tags: ["shim.source=host"]
histograms:
  - name: residency_ms
    buckets: [1,5,10,50,100,500,1000]
```
kevin: for the hint API sketch:
`bool hint_residency(pool_id_t id, struct residency_hint { bool prefer_host; uint32_t ttl_ms; })`
keep it small so we can land fast.
arjun: i'll open the API PR today and add a small shim in the legacy allocator path. i'll also add a microbenchmark; baseline shows ~60ms p99 delta when host pages are >50% under a synthetic eviction churn.
deploy-bot: canary started on staging at 1720000005 :rocket:
liz: solid. metrics/alerts we should watch:
  - p50/p95/p99 latency for generation routes
  - residency_ms p95 where shim.source=host
  - page-fault/swap counts per-second
rollback criteria: p95 > baseline * 1.10 OR p99 increase > 100ms
arjun: ETA EOD for PR. i'll include a toggle env var `REDWOOD_DISABLE_HOST_SHIM` for quick rollback.
maria: i'll add dashboards and an alert rule: `residency_ms.p95[shim.source=host] > 300ms` and post links once ready.
kevin: can we add a small note to the rollout doc about eviction patterns that will flag flaky workloads? e.g. prefix-heavy decoding paths cause high churn.
liz: yes — i'll update the runbook. small follow-up: we need a synthetic harness that simulates prefix-heavy decode to validate under load.
arjun: i have a script that does N streams with short prefixes and random tail lengths. command:
```
./tools/sim_eviction --streams 200 --prefix-weight 0.9 --tail-mean 20
```
i'll push it to the infra repo and point the canary to it.
liz: great. @arjun @maria please link PRs and dashboards in this thread once done. we'll reconvene tomorrow 10am for a short check-in. :thumbsup:
kevin: noted.
liz: thanks everyone — closing this check-in.
